caption: The drawing depicts a square arrangement of hexagonal patches that are reminiscent of a quilt pattern. There are a total of thirteen hexagons, each filled with a different color and texture. The colors present include shades of red, black, green, light blue, pale purple, beige, and dark brown. The central row consists of three red hexagons and one black hexagon. The other hexagons bordering the central row are of various colors, including green, light blue, black, beige, and pale purple. Each hexagon is outlined, giving them a distinct separation from each other. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, and the composition is centered on the page. The drawing contains some visible shading and highlights, giving the hexagons a textured, almost three-dimensional appearance. The artist's signature, "C. Goodwin," is visible in the bottom right corner below the illustrated area.
title: Quilt (detail) - "Honeycomb Pattern"
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
